defective_pattern: Combining row number, variable name, and subscale into a single leading column in correlation or descriptive tables (e.g., flattening hierarchical variable data).
why_defective: Wastes cell width, conflates construct names with subscale dimensions, prevents structured parsing, and violates APA 7th Edition hierarchical presentation standards.
observed_symptoms: Correlation table column 1 containing '۱. رفتارهای خودآسیبی کلی' or '۴. خلق منفی'
Absence of distinct 'ردیف', 'متغیر', and 'خرده‌مقیاس' (or 'مؤلفه') columns in correlation matrices
Merged single-column variable data (e.g., ["متغیرها"] or ["متغیر/سازه"]) in Table 4-13, 4-15, 4-16, and 4-19
corrective_remedy: Expand the table to have 3 distinct prefix columns before numbering/data: Col 1: 'ردیف', Col 2: 'متغیر', Col 3: 'مؤلفه' (or 'خرده‌مقیاس').

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect markdown tables containing single merged headers like | متغیرها | or | متغیر/سازه | without separate ردیف and مؤلفه.
